amendments.disclosure: the frozen ladder served 1398 of 1624 reachable keys from the neutral state and kept a late, first-half or overtime state for only 226; for 5-7|40-49|q4|le120|trail4_8 (fourth and 5-7 at the opponent's 40-49, trailing by 4-8 in the last 2:00) it read the neutral cell 5-7/40-49/neutral (go/field goal/punt 9/1/275) where the real clubs of that state decided 141/0/1; amendment F1 reads */Z40-59/q4|le120|trail4_8 (34/0/0). The amendment changes the rung order on structural grounds (the game state before the field geometry for late decisions; the zone always kept so a field-goal decision follows the kick distance); MIN_CELL, the bins, the states and the counts are unchanged, and no target rate was used
amendments.what: the collapse ladder: a late (fourth quarter, 600 s or less), first-half (120 s or less) or overtime state is kept, with coarse distance and zone, then any distance and coarse zone, then with its time buckets (overtime margins) merged, before it gives way to the neutral state; a field zone, at least its coarse zone, is kept on every rung
amendments.when: after the frozen ladder (specification section 3) was run and printed, before any kernel use

amendments.disclosure: the F1 chart read back on its own rows decided fewer gos than the real clubs: in the last two minutes of the fourth quarter F1 357.4 against 449 real, overall F1 1787.6 against 1915 real; for 1|70-99|q4|le120|trail4_8 (fourth and 1 in the club's own territory, trailing by 4-8 in the last 2:00) F1 read */Z60-99/q4|le600|trail4_8 (go/field goal/punt 42/0/108) where the real clubs of that state decided 141/0/1, because merging the last two minutes with the earlier time buckets brought in clubs that still had time to punt; amendment F2 reads */W40-99/q4|le120|trail4_8 (61/0/1). Wide zones split the field at the opponent's 40: 24 of the 10893 real fourth-down decisions at the opponent's 40 or beyond were field goals, against 3854 of 5333 inside it. The alternative of widening every late state before merging (for the record) reads wide_all 422.6 against 449 real and wide_all 1838.2 against 1915 real; F2 was chosen over it by this read-back on the 2010-2014 rows (its earlier time buckets read closer under F1's merge), not by an acceptance reading. R14's mask moves a trailing overtime offense's punt share to go. MIN_CELL, the bins, the states and the counts are unchanged

masks.rule: pre-build specification R14: a trailing overtime offense's punt is masked, its weight moved to going for it (0 punts in the real trailing overtime decisions)

amendments.what: the collapse ladder and one mask: a last-two-minutes state (q4|le120|<need>) widens its field zone to the field-goal-range boundary (wide zones 1-39 and 40-99) within that state before its time bucket is merged with the earlier ones, and every merged state widens its zone the same way before it gives way to the neutral state; the pre-build specification's R14 applies to the chart (a trailing overtime offense's punt share moves to go)
amendments.when: after the acceptance runs of the F1 chart (October 16, 2026: three trailing-overtime punts against R14's zero-tolerance row, and the late trailing-punt rows; runtime/README.md, batch B9F), before any kernel release

information_boundary: NFL regular seasons 2010-2013 and 2014 Weeks 1-4 (games through September 29, 2014), cut at fetch; no club, game, player or date field. 2013 and 2014 Weeks 1-4 are an anonymous post-divergence league population (pooled only).

rules.conversion_rows: go rows with no penalty flag; converted = an offensive touchdown or yards at least the distance, with no interception or lost fumble
rules.decision_rows: regular-season snaps at down 4 with play_type punt, field_goal, run or pass; no_play rows, kneels and spikes excluded; overtime from 2012
rules.goal_to_go: the distance equals the line (pass 2 confirms the source's goal_to_go column)

masks.rule: pre-build specification R14: a trailing overtime offense's punt is masked, its weight moved to going for it (0 punts in the real trailing overtime decisions)

second_pass.independence: both files derive from the NFL GSIS feed; the second pass reads the raw rows, the source's own goal_to_go column and its own flags
second_pass.source: nflscrapR reg_pbp 2010-2014 (2014 cut), parsed by separately written code (pass2_rows)
